_description: Output schema for validation agents. Write to validated/{slug}.json.
_note_shared: Shared across price-update and tool-update validation. Only confirmed changes are applied.
_note_plan_id: For tool-update plans-scoped changes (field starts with `plans.<idx>.`), copy `plan_id` verbatim from the input change. The numeric index in `field` is informational; apply matches on (plan_id, leaf-suffix, new). For vendor.*, platform.*, capabilities.*, and verification_override changes, omit `plan_id` — apply matches those on the full `field` path.
